A max absolute edge has normalized value 1; cyclic closure sum e_j=0 yields four feasible neighbor regions. n=3 neighbors sum -1 (strict p>2 minimization or concave p<=2 endpoint); n=4 neighbor sum in [-2,0] (H=|a-b|); n=5 neighbor sum<=1 and monotonic optimum x+y=1 (concave p<2 power norm / max for p>=2); n>=6 neighbors can both be 1 using remaining -3/(n-3). Every scalar optimum is integrated to real cyclic vertex slopes, giving an attained instantaneous K=max(H-d), not merely an upper bound. Dini max rule + convex flow well-posedness proves L nonincrease iff K<=0. For n>=6 sum_i(a_i+b_i-d_i)=0; K<=0 forces equality of mass-weighted differences and then all c_i equal. Pentagon c=(1,1,1,1,3/2) yields unique p≈1.336485730165 transition via strictly decreasing ℓ_r norm. Independent 500 exact rational p=3 witnesses and root check corroborated finite cases; general proof is analytic and includes p=2 method as antecedent.
